claims.claim: ACOs that hit quality standards can share in the savings they generate.

claims.sourceSpan: Medicare Clinical Quality Measures for Accountable Care Organizations Participating in the Medicare Shared Savings Program
claims.note: Also (I) Electronic clinical quality measures, (II) MIPS clinical quality measures.

claims.claim: Public analysis and recommendations due by December 31, 2032.

claims.sourceSpan: are available with respect to each measure described in subparagraph (A)(i) required to be reported by an ACO under this paragraph

claims.claim: The MSSP lets provider groups act as ACOs coordinating care for Medicare fee-for-service beneficiaries.

claims.note: Three named types verbatim in subclauses (I)-(III).

claims.sourceSpan: for a performance year beginning on or after January 1, 2025

claims.claim: The Secretary may not treat an ACO's data as unrepresentative solely because it excludes data from one or more ACO participants.
claims.sourceSpan: the Secretary may not find such data to be unrepresentative
claims.note: Polarity: prohibition ('may not find ... unrepresentative') matches; exclusion basis '1 or more ACO participants'.

claims.sourceSpan: the data completeness requirements applicable to such measure under section 414.1340 of title 42

claims.claim: The Secretary may implement the clause by program instruction or otherwise.
claims.sourceSpan: The Secretary may implement this clause by program instruction or otherwise

claims.claim: Further amends Section 1899(b)(3)(B) to require the Secretary to establish a digital quality measure reporting pilot program for each of performance years 2028 through 2032.
claims.sourceSpan: For each of performance years 2028 through 2032, the Secretary shall establish a digital quality measure reporting pilot program
claims.note: Amendment vehicle: 'as amended by section 2, is further amended'.

claims.claim: The Secretary selects ACOs from among applicants.
claims.sourceSpan: The Secretary shall select ACOs to participate in the program for a performance year from among ACOs that submit an application

claims.claim: For each performance year the Secretary specifies 2 measures the selected ACOs report through a digital quality measure collection type.
claims.sourceSpan: the Secretary shall specify 2 measures described in subparagraph (A)(i) otherwise required to be reported by ACOs

claims.claim: The Secretary may not require them to report other measures.
claims.sourceSpan: The Secretary may not require an ACO selected under subclause (II) for a performance year to report data on any measure

claims.claim: Data for those measures is not counted toward quality performance standards or an ACO participant's quality performance category score.
claims.sourceSpan: whether such ACO has met quality performance standards established by the Secretary under subparagraph (C)
claims.note: Also (bb) 'any score for the quality performance category ... for an ACO participant'; disregard = 'may not take into account any data'.

claims.claim: The Secretary provides technical assistance as practicable.
claims.sourceSpan: The Secretary shall provide such technical assistance to ACOs selected to participate in the program as is practicable

claims.claim: Requires the Secretary, not later than December 31, 2032, to publicly post (or include in annual rulemaking) an analysis of the pilot and related recommendations.
claims.sourceSpan: Not later than December 31, 2032, the Secretary shall publicly post (or include as part of annual rulemaking for this section)
claims.note: Analysis = (aa) 'An analysis of the program'.

claims.claim: The posting must include recommendations for increasing submissions through the digital collection type.
claims.sourceSpan: Any recommendations for increasing submissions of data for measures described in subparagraph (A)(i) through the collection type specified in subclause (I)

claims.claim: The posting must include a proposed timeline for eventually requiring measures to be submitted through it.
claims.sourceSpan: A proposed timeline for requiring such measures to be submitted through such collection type
claims.note: 'eventually' is a soft gloss on a forward-looking proposed timeline; faithful.

claims.claim: Data an ACO submits for the pilot's specified measures, and any measures it is relieved from reporting, are not taken into account in judging whether the ACO met quality performance standards or in a participant's quality performance category score.
claims.sourceSpan: The Secretary may not take into account any data for a measure specified under subclause (III)
claims.note: Also covers 'any data for a measure with respect to which such ACO is not required to report' and both (aa) standards / (bb) category score.

claims.claim: A participating ACO's pilot-year quality results carry no consequence for its quality-standard determinations.
claims.sourceSpan: whether such ACO has met quality performance standards established by the Secretary under subparagraph (C)
claims.note: Grounded interpretation of the disregard clause; pilot data excluded from standards determination.

claims.claim: The bill requires three collection types be available for 2025-2029 but does not specify what must be available after 2029.
claims.sourceSpan: For performance years 2025 through 2029, the Secretary shall ensure that the following collection types
claims.note: Accurate observation: availability window is bounded at 2029; no post-2029 provision exists in source.

claims.claim: The bill establishes a digital reporting pilot through 2032 but does not set criteria for how the Secretary selects participating ACOs beyond requiring an application.
claims.sourceSpan: from among ACOs that submit an application at such time and in such form and manner as specified by the Secretary
claims.note: Accurate: selection provision states only application submission, no substantive criteria.

claims.claim: The bill directs a proposed timeline for eventually requiring digital submission but does not itself set any deadline for making digital reporting mandatory.
claims.sourceSpan: A proposed timeline for requiring such measures to be submitted through such collection type
claims.note: Accurate: bill requires only a proposed timeline, sets no mandatory-reporting deadline itself.

claims.claim: New requirement that three collection types (eCQMs, MIPS CQMs, and Medicare CQMs for ACOs) remain available for ACO quality reporting for performance years 2025-2029.
claims.sourceSpan: For performance years 2025 through 2029, the Secretary shall ensure that the following collection types
claims.note: Added via '(2) by adding at the end the following new clauses'.

claims.claim: New data-completeness protection barring the Secretary from deeming ACO data unrepresentative solely for excluding a participant that could not collect through the selected collection type.
claims.sourceSpan: such ACO participant was unable to collect such data through the collection type (as described in clause (ii)) selected by the ACO

claims.claim: New digital quality measure reporting pilot program for performance years 2028-2032, with a public analysis due by December 31, 2032.
claims.sourceSpan: For each of performance years 2028 through 2032, the Secretary shall establish a digital quality measure reporting pilot program
claims.note: Analysis deadline verbatim: 'Not later than December 31, 2032'.

claims.claim: Amends Section 1899(b)(3)(B) (42 U.S.C. 1395jjj(b)(3)(B)) to restructure the ACO reporting-requirements clause and add the collection-type, data-completeness, and pilot provisions.
claims.sourceSpan: 1395jjj(b)(3)(B)) is amended--
claims.note: Restructure = strike 'An ACO shall submit' + insert '(i) In general'; add = '(2) by adding at the end the following new clauses'.
